newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Securicor Telesciences changes name, plans IPO.
newsitem.headline: Securicor Telesciences changes name, plans IPO.

text.p: Securicor Telesciences Inc, a US$2 billion world-wide billing data collection company, said on Tuesday it had changed its name to Axiom Inc and would soon make an initial public offering (IPO).
"Our new name reflects the absolute value we offer our customers," Axiom international vice president John F. Mahoney, told a news conference.
The public offering would be valued at 45 percent of the company and Securicor would still have primary ownership, Mahoney said, without giving further details.
Axiom Inc. which serves telephone operators, was also introducing a number of new products for billing data collection and processing, traffic management and fraud control, he added.
